raw.details:
Overview:

Welcome to the Decentralized Mesh Protocol Hackathon 2026! This is an open-source, contribution-based hackathon designed for developers, C++ enthusiasts, and IoT/robotics builders. Participants will tackle real-world issues in dynamic node routing, swarm network optimization, testing, and documentation to build robust edge infrastructure.

Important Dates & Timeline:

  • Hackathon Start Date: Immediate Access!
  • Final Submission Deadline: September 30, 2026 (11:59 PM IST)
  • Winner Announcement: Post-evaluation after October 5, 2026.

Eligibility & Guidelines:

  • Eligibility: Open to all students, open-source enthusiasts, and developers (undergraduate, post-graduate, and school students welcome).
  • Team Size: Individual participation (1 member per team/handle) or small teams up to 3 members.
  • Inter-College Teams: Allowed! Teammates can be from different colleges/institutions.
  • Inter-Specialization Teams: Allowed! Members can belong to any domain (CSE, ECE, Mechanical, etc.).
  • Number of Problem Statements / Issues: 10+ categorized open GitHub issues ranging across easy, medium, and hard difficulty levels.

Rules & Integrity Guidelines:

  • Issue Assignment Required: Do NOT open a PR without an explicitly assigned issue. Unassigned PRs will be closed.
  • Strictly PR-Based: Direct commits to the main branch are blocked. All submissions must come via GitHub Pull Requests.
  • No Spam / Quality Control: Submissions with cosmetic-only changes (e.g., random whitespace fixes, minor typo spamming without value) will be rejected immediately with zero points.
  • Code Quality: All C++/Embedded code must compile cleanly using PlatformIO / CMake without standard build errors.

Leaderboard Points:

  • level: easy = 10 – 15 Points
  • level: medium = 20 – 25 Points
  • level: hard = 35 – 40 Points

Prizes & Rewards Pool:

  • 1st Rank (Winner): ₹10,000 Cash Prize + Exclusive Swag Bag + Winner Certificate + Core Team Invite
  • 2nd Rank (Runner Up): ₹5,000 Cash Prize + Exclusive Swag Bag + Runner-up Certificate
  • 3rd Rank (Second Runner Up): ₹2,500 Cash Prize + Exclusive Swag Bag + Certificate of Merit
  • Ranks 4th to 30th: ₹1,000 Cash Prize Each + Premium Swags + Certificate of Excellence

Perks & Swag Kits (Worth ₹10,000+)

Top contributors ko milenge exclusive physical & digital perks:

  • Custom Swag Bags: Branded T-shirts, Laptop Stickers, Badges & Developer Wristbands
  • Certificate of Contribution: Verified digital certificates for ALL participants with merged PRs
  • Fast-Track Mentorship & Core Team Invite: Top coders ko project ka Core Maintainer banne ka chance
  • GitHub Profile Highlight: Project README par top contributors ka feature
